name: TriagePilot - Route triage result
description: Applies the agent's suggestion on its own when it is confident, otherwise asks the Service Desk to approve it.

steps.name: Route the result
steps.notes: Auto-applies category and group when status is completed, confidence >= x_tp.auto_route_threshold and priority is not 1 or 2. Otherwise creates a sysapproval_approver record for the group in x_tp.approval_group. Failed runs only leave a work note.
